nodes.display_name: Hydro Power Energy - ContentsDA Science Experiment
nodes.long_description:
1. build a generator to light up your surroundings because it is too dark.
2. Assemble the parts to complete the hydroelectric generator. 
3. Connect the generator controller and transformer with wires and turn on the light.
4. As the generator runs, it powers and lights up the neighborhood.

- You will notice that when the flow and velocity of the water increases (in a rainy environment), more power is generated.
nodes.short_description: Explore the power of water in generating electricity. Understand the mechanics behind hydroelectric power, a major renewable energy source.
